title: Credits Set Against a Retainage Release on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Credits Set Against a Retainage Release

Credits standing on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects are taken off the retainage going out, in a part that depends on how far behind the owner's account stands.

## Rule

Where credits stand on the project and the amount standing unpaid on its contract billings is more than a tenth of the contract value, that is more than 10 per cent of it, the whole of those credits is set against the release: **100 per cent** of them.

Where credits stand on the project and the amount standing unpaid on its contract billings is a tenth of the contract value or less, nothing standing unpaid included, **50 per cent** of those credits is set against the release and the rest is settled on the account.

Where no credit stands on the project, nothing is set against the release: **0 per cent**.

## Both sides of the tenth

The tenth is taken on the contract value and rounded to the nearest cent. An amount standing unpaid above that figure takes the first case; an amount exactly equal to it, and any smaller amount down to and including nothing standing unpaid, takes the second.

| Credits on the project | Amount standing unpaid against a tenth of the contract value | Portion of the credits set against the release |
|---|---|---|
| USD 5000 | above a tenth | USD 5000.00 |
| USD 5000 | exactly a tenth | USD 2500.00 |
| USD 5000 | below a tenth | USD 2500.00 |
| USD 5000 | nothing unpaid | USD 2500.00 |
| none | any | nothing |

## Worked case (hypothetical)

A project with a contract value of USD 600000 has a tenth of USD 60000. With USD 8000 of credits standing and USD 70000 unpaid on the contract billings, the whole USD 8000 is set against the release. With the same credits and USD 45000 unpaid, USD 4000 is set against the release and the other USD 4000 is settled on the account.
